CVE-2026-24049.e36b99224d3c4267c0ef58ce9f52d42295662ac1:
🔧 chore(changelog): drop dead CVE fragment

docs/changelog/CVE-2026-24049.fix.rst has sat unpublished since #3167 in
June. towncrier only recognises feature, bugfix, doc, removal and misc, and
pyproject.toml configures no extra types, so the fix extension made towncrier
skip the file. Six releases went out without it, including 21.7.11 today.

Renaming it to a valid type would announce a wheel bump that shipped in
21.4.3 and was undone in the next commit, #3168. virtualenv stopped embedding
wheel altogether in #3170, and v21.5.0 already records "Removed wheel of
0.47.0", so the bump has no audience left. Deleting beats publishing a
three-month-old note about a seed package that is gone.
CVE-2026-24049.5389c25cf4a1ee11ea55183d6daf4c8055dc3060:
Add wheel-0.47.0 to seed packages as mitigation of CVE-2026-24049 (#3167)

Hi!

Me and my team ran into the issue that even with the latest version of
`virtualenv` each venv gets seeded with `wheel 0.45.1`, which is
vulnerable in terms of
[CVE-2026-24049](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-24049).
This PR adds the most current version of the `wheel` package to the list
of seeding packages at the time this PR was authored.
